briefdescription.para: Create an MCJIT execution engine for a module, with the given options.

detaileddescription.para: It is the responsibility of the caller to ensure that all fields in Options up to the given SizeOfOptions are initialized. It is correct to pass a smaller value of SizeOfOptions that omits some fields. The canonical way of using this is:

LLVMMCJITCompilerOptions options; LLVMInitializeMCJITCompilerOptions(&options, sizeof(options)); ... fill in those options you care about LLVMCreateMCJITCompilerForModule(&jit, mod, &options, sizeof(options), &error);
